title: economic-blueprint-exporter-and-batch-shaper-cli
author: Nina Patel
release_notes: Adds a CLI to export tenant economic blueprints, a lightweight telemetry sampler for batch-shaping signals, and a quantization hint exporter for safe defaults. Non-breaking; opt-in behind feature flag.
description: Motivation: Customers and internal SREs repeatedly ask for a compact, auditable representation of tenant-level unit economics and the heuristics we apply for batching/caching/quantization. This PR introduces a small CLI tool (rbx-econ-export) and a runtime telemetry sampler that produces 'blueprints' used by the cost ops team and by the new policy engine. The exporter serializes batched profiles, cache hit distributions, quant hint scores, and suggested safe defaults (tiered) into a compact JSONL format. The batch-shaper runtime hook records per-route shape metrics (median/95th tokens, observed concurrency, KV-cache reuse) and tags samples with model variant fingerprints. The goal is reproducible defaults that can be consumed by the Optimize tooling and by audits.
